title: COMMIT YOUR PLANS
TO THE LORD
end: The Guided Path — seek God's wisdom for every step

scenes.a: Before you finalize that choice you have been replaying all night, step back and pray.
Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.
Heavenly Father, I bring my plans, my projects, and my uncertain steps before You.
scenes.sub: BRING YOUR PLANS TO THE LORD

scenes.a: I lay down the urge to control every single detail, asking You to align my heart with Your perfect divine direction.
When my mind feels restless or scattered, quiet my fears and let Your calm wisdom establish my thoughts today.
Subscribe to The Guided Path for daily biblical wisdom and prayer.
